nina: Small PR up to add a one-page quick-reference for Optimize: batching, kv_prefetch, and a short quant_profile note. Includes tiny Python + Node examples and a 3-row relative-impact table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5632
omar: Paste the snippets here so I can check fields
nina: Python:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
r = c.generate(model='rwd/opt-6b-q4', input='Sum:', batch_size=2, kv_prefetch=True, quant_profile='q4_128')
print(r.output)
```
Node:
```js
const {RedwoodClient} = require('@redwood-inference/sdk')
const c = new RedwoodClient()
const r = await c.generate({model:'rwd/opt-6b-q4', input:'Sum:', batch_size:2, kv_prefetch:true, quant_profile:'q4_128'})
console.log(r.output)
```
tara: Please note: SDK v0.12+ uses `output` not `text` and `kv_prefetch` replaces `kv_cache`. Add a Dedicated note to pin quant_profile.
